sections.routeReview: The arrival ends above Gays Mills Dam. The USGS candidate also retains an old river bend that differs from the visible channel, so its dotted path remains under review. Exact landing connections are not mapped.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Kickapoo Valley Reserve — Upper Kickapoo River Guide, March 2026
takeOutAccess.note: The March 2026 agency river guide and 2026–2030 management plan establish public carry-in access at Landing 18. The area center uses the unchanged DNR monitoring-station coordinate for Bridge 18 (station 10032190, historic 2010 fieldwork), corroborated by agency maps and satellite imagery. This is a bridge-area anchor, not a boat-ramp GIS coordinate or proof of the exact landing/bank. Earlier map-georeferencing estimates were superseded by this agency coordinate; exact landing remains open for reviewed user corrections.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Landing 18 access near the Old Highway 131 covered bridge, west of the reserve visitor center. The reserve says a short carry connects the landing and parking. Check the signed approach while arranging your shuttle; this area marker is not a driving destination or a confirmed water-edge landing.

mapAuditNote: Access areas reviewed against current agency records. Exact water-edge landings have not been established for every endpoint; sections with unresolved permission or dam/portage questions are held separately.
